decision: defined account dates, rolling filters, and role-plus-owner content permissions as the completion predicate
why: these are the three requested user-visible behaviors and the security boundary

decision: confirmed users has created_at but no updated_at, lessons have updated_by, and question rows lack visible ownership metadata
why: ownership and edit dates must be persisted rather than inferred from the current session

decision: superseded the initial placeholder timestamps with the session clock time
why: the first two rows used a placeholder time rather than a measured timestamp

decision: stored content ownership separately from the last editor
why: updated_by changes whenever staff edit and cannot represent stable ownership

decision: defined 1 month and 1 year as rolling periods ending at NOW()
why: the interface states the period rule and the API uses PostgreSQL intervals

decision: added a repeatable v4 migration for existing PostgreSQL databases and matching fresh-install fields
why: existing installations need the new columns and triggers before these API queries deploy

decision: restricted teachers to their own lesson and question rows while admins and officers retain full editing
why: write endpoints enforce ownership and editor views expose read-only state

decision: JavaScript syntax and diff whitespace checks passed; PHP lint could not run because PHP CLI is unavailable
why: the available checks passed but no PHP parser or live database was available

decision: independent cross-model trail review could not run under the active no-delegation policy
why: the policy allows subagents only when the user requests delegation

decision: superseded the earlier check row after the final JavaScript and diff checks passed
why: the checks were rerun after the last code edits; PHP lint and live DB verification remain unavailable

decision: left missing historical edit timestamps unknown instead of copying signup dates
why: showing a guessed edit time would mislead account and content managers
